title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-29
source: Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones; Transferred on Mason's restored Nak550

ai_review.summary: Solid audience recording with clear positioning captures a high‑energy Red Rocks show that fans rank as the best of the three nights.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this performance, calling it the top night out of the three shows at Red Rocks and noting the taper’s good placement that makes it car‑friendly listening. The recording is regarded as solid and enjoyable, though no detailed technical commentary is provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight a strong show and satisfactory recording quality; limited detail keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taper’s positioning praised; clear enough for enjoyable listening, no specific issues reported.
